covers: 4 November 2026, first hour of Wall Street trading (16:30–17:20 SAST) and US data; JSE closed for local elections
headline: Dow extends gains to +1,107 points (+2.1%) after the Democratic sweep; Apple hits a record, chip and defense stocks slip
summary: Wall Street built on its opening rally: at 10:17 a.m. New York time (17:17 SAST) the Dow was at 52,893.50, up 1,106.78 points or 2.14%, with Apple up about 6% to an all-time high (Yahoo Finance, 4 Nov). Healthcare and solar stocks led, while chip, data-centre and defense names fell on worries a Democratic Congress will add oversight of data-centre building and push for a quicker end to the US-Iran war; the 10-year Treasury yield was 4.92% (Business Insider, 4 Nov), and ISM services eased to 54.5 ahead of Friday's jobs report. The JSE is closed for local elections; gold near $4,054 and a rand around R16.45/$ are a supportive set-up for local miners when trading resumes on Thursday.

items.title: Dow up 1,107 points (+2.14%) at 52,893.50 an hour into trading; Apple +6% to a record
items.summary: At 10:17 a.m. New York time (17:17 SAST) the Dow was at 52,893.50, up 1,106.78 points or 2.14%, extending its opening gain; the S&P 500 was up about 1.1% and the Nasdaq about 1% in the live report. Apple rose about 6% to an all-time high, while Nvidia and Micron slipped more than 1% (Yahoo Finance, 4 Nov). At the open the Dow had been up 1,009 points (ABC News, 4 Nov).
items.source: Yahoo Finance, 4 Nov 2026; ABC News, 4 Nov 2026

items.title: Earlier: Dow opened 1,009 points higher (+1.9%); S&P 500 and Nasdaq both +1.1%
items.summary: At about 9:35 a.m. New York time (16:35 SAST) the Dow was up 1,009 points, or 1.9%, and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq were each up 1.1%, as investors welcomed a Democratic Congress as a check on new White House policy (ABC News, 4 Nov). The 10-year Treasury yield was slightly above 4.9% and the 30-year around 5.3%, mostly lower on the day (Epoch Times, 4 Nov).
items.source: ABC News, 4 Nov 2026; Epoch Times, 4 Nov 2026

items.title: ISM services PMI 54.5 in October (54.9 in September); prices index 73.0
items.summary: Business activity slowed to 53.8 from 56.5 and new orders to 55.9 from 59.8, while employment improved to 51.4 from 50.1. The prices paid index eased one point to 73.0, still a high reading. Any reading above 50 means the services sector is growing.

items.title: ADP: US private employers added 86,000 jobs in October
items.summary: September was revised down to 86,000 from 90,000. Pay for job-stayers rose 3.0% year on year and for job-changers 4.8%. Professional and business services lost 27,000 jobs, a third straight monthly decline. The official October jobs report is due on Friday.

items.title: Euro zone inflation hits 4.0% in October, highest since 2023
items.summary: Eurostat's flash estimate put October inflation at 4.0%, up from 3.8% in September; core inflation was 2.5% and energy prices were up 20.8% on a year earlier. Markets priced a better than 72% chance of an ECB quarter-point hike on 17 December, after hikes in June and September took the deposit rate to 2.5% (Martin Cid Magazine, 4 Nov).

items.title: Democrats take both houses of Congress: AP count gives them 53 Senate seats; CNN and CBS project the House
items.summary: AP called the Senate for Democrats late on Tuesday US time after Josh Turek won Iowa (Forbes, 4 Nov). By AP's running count at about 08:24 SAST Democrats had 53 Senate seats to the Republicans' 42, with 5 uncalled (Investing.com, 4 Nov). The House was projected for Democrats by CNN and CBS, and earlier by Decision Desk HQ; they needed to flip only three Republican seats and easily exceeded that (The National, 4 Nov). Reuters' Morning Bid also notes the Texas governorship flipped to Democrats, which analysts see as a risk to data-centre expansion in the state. A Democratic Congress makes new tax-cut or spending laws from the White House harder to pass.
items.source: Forbes, 4 Nov 2026; Investing.com, 4 Nov 2026; The National, 4 Nov 2026; Reuters Morning Bid via Investing.com, 4 Nov 2026

items.title: Election winners and losers: healthcare and solar up; data-centre, chip and defense stocks down
items.summary: Wednesday-morning moves in New York: Molina and HCA Healthcare +6%, Centene +4%, Invesco Solar ETF +6%. On the losing side, SpaceX −7%, Tesla −4%, CoreWeave −7%, IREN −10%, Intel and Micron −2%, Nvidia and Broadcom −1%, Lockheed Martin and Northrop Grumman −3%, RTX −2%, and Trump Media −10%. Chip and data-centre selling reflects worries Democrats will add regulation and oversight of data-centre building; defense selling reflects the chance of a quicker end to the US-Iran war. Treasury yields edged lower: 2-year 4.59%, 10-year 4.92%, 30-year 5.30% (Business Insider via AOL, published 17:32 SAST, 4 Nov).

items.title: CVS Health to split into two listed companies by the first half of 2028
items.summary: One company would hold Aetna, CVS Caremark, CVS Specialty, Oak Street Health and Signify Health under CEO David Joyner; the other, CVS Pharmacy, would hold about 9,000 pharmacies, mail pharmacy and MinuteClinic under CEO Prem Shah. The split is meant to be tax-free and needs final board approval (CVS 8-K, 4 Nov). CVS also raised its 2026 guidance; the shares were down 4.84% pre-market at 9:03 a.m. New York time (Stock Titan, 4 Nov).
items.source: CVS Health (SEC filing), 4 Nov 2026; Stock Titan, 4 Nov 2026

items.title: Pre-market: Tesla −5.52%; AMD and Super Micro near flat at 9:03 a.m. New York time
items.summary: Before the open, Dow futures were up 1,083 points (+2.1%) at 8:45 a.m. New York time and S&P 500 futures 1.1%; Nasdaq-100 futures were up 0.4% at 9:05 a.m. AMD and Super Micro had given back their overnight results gains to trade nearly flat (Stock Titan, citing CNBC, 4 Nov).

items.title: Uber Q3: revenue $14.8bn (+10%), gross bookings $59.8bn (+20%), adjusted EBITDA $3.0bn (+31%)
items.summary: Net income was $512m, including a $476m pre-tax loss on equity investments. Uber guided Q4 gross bookings to $63.25bn–$65.25bn (18%–22% growth in constant currency) and adjusted EBITDA to $3.13bn–$3.23bn.

items.title: Analysts: Democratic Congress adds policy risk for AI and data centres, but gridlock limits near-term change
items.summary: Bank of America's base case is gridlock because Democrats lack a veto-proof Senate majority, and it sees any equity sell-off as temporary; RBC described the move as continued de-risking in AI and big-cap growth rather than broad risk-off.

items.title: McDonald's Q3: adjusted EPS $3.57 (+11%), but US comparable sales down 0.2%
items.summary: Revenue rose 1% to $7.16 billion and global comparable sales grew 1.5%, slower than 3.6% a year ago; US comparable sales fell 0.2% against 2.4% growth a year earlier (company release, 4 Nov).

items.title: JSE closed today for local elections; rand firms to about R16.45/$
items.summary: USD/ZAR was about 16.45, down 0.89% on the day, as the dollar weakened after the US midterms; JSE Top 40 futures were quoted 0.43% lower. Trading resumes on Thursday.

items.title: New fuel prices in force from today: diesel down R1.10–R1.20 a litre, petrol down 1c
items.summary: From 00:01 on Wednesday 4 November, 93 and 95 petrol fall 1c a litre, diesel 0.05% falls R1.10 and diesel 0.005% R1.20, while illuminating paraffin (wholesale) rises R2.75 a litre and LPGas R1.83/kg, per the Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources. The general fuel levy cut (R1.50/l petrol, R3/l diesel) is partly offset by a new slate levy of 135.84c/l. Cheaper diesel helps transport, farming and mining costs (Stuff, 3 Nov).

items.title: US to suspend South Africa from AGOA from 1 January 2027
items.summary: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told Congress that South Africa and Rwanda would be suspended from AGOA from 1 January 2027, citing human rights, corruption and threats to US interests. The trade ministry said it would support affected sectors; ETM Analytics said markets had largely priced it in. On 3 November at 08:30 SAST the rand was R16.62/$ and the 2035 bond yield 8.51% (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 3 Nov). Vehicle, citrus and other farm exporters are the most exposed.

items.title: Oil lower: Brent −1.2% to $102.35, WTI −0.8% to $95.31; euro $1.1255
items.summary: Figures at 8:28 a.m. New York time (15:28 SAST), after President Trump said there were no immediate plans for further strikes on Iran. The euro rose to $1.1255 from $1.1194 and the yen was 158.30 per dollar (AP via BNN Bloomberg, 4 Nov). Cheaper oil helps South Africa's import bill and fuel prices.

items.title: Dollar index −0.6% to a one-month low of 101.27; euro $1.1258, yen 157.92
items.summary: Reuters reported the dollar index down 0.6% at 101.27, a one-month low, on worries a Democratic Congress will add AI regulation; the euro rose 0.6% to $1.1258, sterling 0.3% to $1.3458 and the yen strengthened nearly 0.8% to 157.92 per dollar (Reuters via Investing.com, 4 Nov). A weaker dollar usually supports the rand, which trades offshore today with the JSE closed.

items.title: Gold near $4,054, up almost 3%; silver futures +4.2% to $51.67
items.summary: By Wednesday afternoon gold was about $4,054 an ounce, up nearly 3% (Business Insider via AOL, 4 Nov). Earlier IG put it at about $4,028 (published 10:48 SAST), with resistance at $4,046–$4,073 and the price still about 28% below January's record just under $5,600 (IG, 4 Nov). At 08:36 SAST December silver futures were up about 4.2% at $51.67 (FinanceFeeds, 4 Nov); at 08:11 SAST platinum was up 1% at $1,432.93 and palladium up 1.7% at $952.50 (Investing.com, 4 Nov). A firmer gold and PGM basket is a better set-up for JSE gold and PGM miners when trading resumes on Thursday.
items.source: Business Insider via AOL, 4 Nov 2026; IG, 4 Nov 2026; FinanceFeeds, 4 Nov 2026; Investing.com, 4 Nov 2026

items.title: Qualcomm (LRC Stock Scanner: HOLD, target $167.20) picked by SpaceX for Starlink Mobile's US 5G ground network; results tonight
items.summary: SpaceX selected Qualcomm's Dragonwing QRU100 and QDU100 platforms for tens of thousands of ground cell sites to sit alongside Starlink Mobile's satellites, with rollout from 2027 under a multiyear deal; no financial terms were given (Anadolu via A News, 4 Nov). Qualcomm reports results after the US close tonight. The deal adds a new infrastructure customer but its size is unknown; the HOLD rating is not changed here.
items.source: A News, 4 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner, 3 Nov 2026

items.title: AMD (LRC Stock Scanner: HOLD, target $641.00): overnight results gain faded to near flat before the open
items.summary: AMD closed regular trade on 3 November at $483.90 and finished after-hours at $508.20, up 5.0% (FinanceFeeds, 4 Nov), but by 9:03 a.m. New York time it was nearly flat (Stock Titan, 4 Nov). Third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $13.38 billion and fourth-quarter guidance of about $17 billion beat consensus of $16.23 billion (AMD; Investing.com, 3 Nov). The price remains well below the scanner's $641.00 target; the HOLD rating is not changed here.
items.source: Stock Titan, 4 Nov 2026; FinanceFeeds, 4 Nov 2026; AMD, 3 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner, 3 Nov 2026

items.title: Super Micro (LRC Stock Scanner: HOLD, target $62.57): early results gain faded to near flat before the open
items.summary: Super Micro was up more than 4% overnight after first-quarter revenue of about $20 billion (Stocktwits, 3 Nov), but was nearly flat at 9:03 a.m. New York time (Stock Titan, 4 Nov). The scanner shows HOLD with a $62.57 target against a last price of $31.29 (3 Nov). The rating is not changed here.
items.source: Stock Titan, 4 Nov 2026; Stocktwits via Yahoo Finance, 3 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner, 3 Nov 2026

items.title: NVIDIA (BUY, target $239.30) about 1% lower and Meta (HOLD, target $547.40) after the open
items.summary: Nvidia was down about 1% on Wednesday morning in New York as chip and data-centre stocks fell on worries a Democratic Congress will add oversight of data-centre construction (Business Insider via AOL, 4 Nov; Yahoo Finance, 4 Nov). The scanner shows NVIDIA at BUY with a $239.30 target (last $207.80) and Meta at HOLD with a $547.40 target (last $620.20), from the 3 Nov 18:45 SAST run; a 1% move does not change that picture. Meta's price move was not verified, so none is given. Ratings are not changed here.
items.source: Business Insider via AOL, 4 Nov 2026; Yahoo Finance, 4 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner, 3 Nov 2026
